verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents its own bulk import, including multi-QR Google Authenticator exports processed in a single session and imports from many providers' export files. It also has whole-vault encrypted export, plus CLI-based export and backup. However, per-item management such as deleting or editing is documented only as a long-press on a single item. Missing for 10: multi-select bulk delete/edit/tag/trash operations, bulk actions beyond import/export, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Import multi-QR Google Authenticator exports in a single session.
Ente Auth also supports imports from Auth's own encrypted exports and plain text files.
You can use [Ente's CLI](https://github.com/ente/ente/tree/main/cli#readme) to automatically backup your Auth codes.
